## Implementation Plan (Auto-Approved)

### Sub-Task 1: Extend TimeBucket with runs_by_status (light)
- File: `acs/src/models/manifest.rs`
- Add `runs_by_status: BTreeMap<String, u64>` to TimeBucket
- Update merge_run() to track status counts

### Sub-Task 2: Add timeframe filtering and response types (standard)
- File: `acs/src/models/manifest.rs`
- Timeframe enum, CostSummary/GlobalCostResponse structs, summarize() method

### Sub-Task 3: Add three route handlers and register routes (standard)
- Files: `acs/src/server/routes.rs`, `acs/src/server/mod.rs`
- GET /api/jobs/{id}/cost-summary, GET /api/costs/summary, GET /api/jobs/{id}/manifest

### Sub-Task 4: Unit tests for all three endpoints (standard)
- File: `acs/src/server/mod.rs`
- Enhance InMemoryLogStore, add 10 test cases

Dependency chain: 1 → 2 → 3 → 4 (sequential)
